summary: Provident Financial Holdings filed an 8-K on July 23, 2026 announcing the declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.14 per share, payable on September 3, 2026 to holders of record on August 13, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer. No deal terms are applicable; the filing contains no special event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. There is nothing to watch or risk-arb angle.
